title: Folding paired updates componentwise
statement: Let $\alpha,\beta,\gamma$ be types, and let $f : \alpha\to\gamma\to\alpha$ and $g : \beta\to\gamma\to\beta$. For initial values $a\in\alpha$ and $b\in\beta$ and any finite list $L$ over $\gamma$, folding the paired update on $(a,b)$ gives the pair consisting of the separate folds of $f$ from $a$ and $g$ from $b$ over $L$.
